jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced **Senior Full Stack Software Engineer** to join our dynamic and growing team. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in designing, building, and maintaining scalable web applications and APIs, leveraging cloud-native technologies. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of software development, from conception to deployment, including designing system architecture, implementing solutions, and optimizing performance.

Deep cloud engineering expertise is essential for this role, including hands-on experience architecting, developing, deploying, and operating production-grade cloud-native applications. The Geospatial Enterprise Open Data Store (GEODS) contract provides integration, design, development, and sustainment for data services in support of the Federal Government.

Regularly, developers on GEODS are involved in designing and implementing new custom features that solve unique problems as well as updating and optimizing legacy features. Each developer has the opportunity to design and implement noticeable and impactful changes to the system as a whole.

This role will join a team of software developers in building, maintaining, and improving interfaces core to the GEODS contract. These interfaces will support the federal government in important business objectives.

**Work Schedule:** Day shift, Monday through Friday.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

As a senior software developer, the expectation is that the candidate will be capable of mostly independent software development and consistent contributions involving architecture, design, and improvement of existing and new systems. The senior will be expected to be self-motivated and maintain consistent and clear communication of progress and capacity to seek direction in performing the job function in order to maintain the big picture goal of the development task.

The senior software developer should be able to guide and mentor, pending gaining their own experience on the program, junior members and new members joining the program as software developers to establish and maintain a consistent culture of quality and collaboration.

jobs.description:
Full Stack Software Engineer II – Web Portal

  

**Who We Are:** USCS is dedicated to advancing, innovating, and serving companies seeking "Best in Service", facilities, and logistics in the cold chain. We are an employee-focused, equal opportunity employer and would love to have you join our team.

  

USCS is one of the largest providers of third-party logistics solutions in North America. The Center of Digital Excellence (CoDE) is the IT division responsible for the company's digital footprint, including custom software development, enterprise integrations, customer-facing applications, data platforms, automation solutions, and infrastructure services.

  

**The Job Details:**

As a third-party logistics provider, we are entrusted with managing and safeguarding our customers' inventory throughout the supply chain. Providing customers with timely access to information and self-service capabilities is critical to delivering an exceptional customer experience.

We are seeking a Full Stack Software Engineer to help design, develop, deploy, and enhance the Web Portal, a modern customer-facing platform that provides visibility into inventory, orders, reporting, and operational activities.

The portal is designed to deliver a modern user experience, leveraging natural language capabilities and contextualized content so customers can quickly find what they are looking for—or be informed of what they should know. It also forms the basis for the APIs and hooks that allow our customers' systems to integrate with ours.

In this role, you will develop web applications, APIs, integrations, and data-driven solutions that support both customers and internal business operations. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, product owners, analysts, quality assurance professionals, and fellow engineers to deliver secure, scalable, reliable, and user-friendly solutions.

Our goal is to complement existing electronic health records, EMS documentation platforms, and hospital infrastructure—not replace them.
